seo.title: Resources — TranquilHaven Coaching
seo.description: Gentle reflective guides and check-ins to support emotional clarity, boundaries, and life transitions.

title: Resources
intro: Reflective prompts and gentle check-ins you can return to anytime — small practices that make space for clarity, without pressure.

body.text: When things feel emotionally unclear, try gently sitting with these questions:

items: What am I feeling right now, without trying to fix it?
What part of this situation feels heavy or unclear?
What do I need more of in this moment — space, clarity, or support?
What am I trying to control that is not fully mine to control?
If I slowed down, what would become more visible?

body.text: There is no need to rush answers. Clarity often comes through noticing, not forcing.
Boundaries are not about distance. They are about clarity.
You may find it helpful to reflect:

items: Where do I feel stretched or emotionally overextended?
What am I saying “yes” to that feels misaligned?
What would a softer, more honest “no” look like here?
What feels emotionally safe for me right now?

body.text: Boundaries often begin as internal awareness before they become external action.

items.title: When You Feel Stuck in a Life Transition

body.text: Transitions can feel confusing because old patterns no longer fit, but new ones are not yet clear.
In these moments, it may help to slow down and ask:

items: What is actually changing in my life right now?
What feels uncertain — and what is still stable?
What expectations am I holding that no longer match reality?
What would it look like to give myself more time?

body.text: Stuckness is often not a lack of direction, but a process of adjustment.
